thread:
maria-support: FYI our customer EduSearch started getting 401s right after the midnight API key rollover in eu-west. They see 'invalid signature' for every request. Happened ~02:14 UTC.
maria-support: Customer supplied a curl sample that fails:
elliot-customer (pasted): ```curl -i -H 'Authorization: ApiKey sk_live_abc123\n' https://api.eu.redwood.example/v1/generate```\nResponse: 401 {\"error\":\"invalid signature\"}
ryan-eng: Can you paste the decoded k8s secret value? Suspect trailing newline/whitespace in env var.
jess-devops: This matches a weird helm values post-renderer behaviour we saw last week when values are supplied as multi-line literals. Quick check: `kubectl get secret edusearch-api-key -n production -o jsonpath='{.data.api_key}' | base64 -d | od -c` -> will show \n if present.
vault-agent-bot: vault-agent: template rendered and secret updated at 2026-03-12T02:13:59Z for path secret/data/edusearch/api-key
maria-support: Ran the command, confirmed there is a trailing `\n` byte. The client sends the newline in the Authorization header, which changes signature. Repro locally by adding `\n` to header.
ryan-eng: Minimal repro we used:
```
# correct
curl -H "Authorization: ApiKey sk_live_abc123" https://api.eu.redwood.example/v1/ping
# bad (note trailing newline)
curl -H $'Authorization: ApiKey sk_live_abc123\n' https://api.eu.redwood.example/v1/ping
```
Response difference is deterministic: bad -> 401 invalid signature.
jess-devops: Immediate mitigation: patch the k8s secret without newline and restart the sidecar. Command we used:
```
kubectl create secret generic edusearch-api-key \
  --from-literal=api_key="$(echo -n 'sk_live_fixed123')" -n production --dry-run=client -o yaml | kubectl apply -f -
kubectl rollout restart deployment/edusearch-sidecar -n production
```
ryan-eng: Longer-term fix: update vault-agent template to `{{- trim .Data.data.api_key }}` (trimspace) and bump helm chart that uses `|` block scalars to avoid appending newlines. Add an integration test to validate no trailing whitespace.
jess-devops: Also opened a quick canary so we rotate only one customer pool at a time and watch SLOs. For this customer we reverted the midnight global swap and rolled a sanitized key back out.
olivia-security: Please capture the Vault path, version and the KMS key id used for the rotated value (we need audit log entries). Also add the incident to SUP-5842 and include the exact base64 diff from the k8s secret.
maria-support: Notified the customer with root cause (trailing newline from templating) and gave ETA for fix + their workaround (restart sidecar). Assigned SUP-5842 to ryan-eng + jess-devops. Closing thread here, will update ticket with postmortem :thumbsup:
